basic_details.job_title: Collectorate Arwal Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for Government Pleader, Assistant Government Pleader Posts
basic_details.short_information: Collectorate Arwal is inviting offline applications for Government Pleader and Assistant Government Pleader posts on a contract basis, which must be submitted through speed post to the Office of the District Magistrate, Arwal by 5:00 PM on 31 October 2026. Candidates applying for these positions must be a law graduate and registered advocate with a minimum of 7 years of practice, and must be an income tax assessee for at least three previous financial years. content_sections.heading: Collectorate Arwal Recruitment 2026 at a Glance

rows.details: 7117/जे0 (Dated 29.12.2020) and subsequent notices including memo 7880/जे0 dated 23.09.2026
Government Pleader and Assistant Government Pleader
Law graduate and registered advocate with minimum 7 years of practice

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted through speed post to the following address: Office of the District Magistrate, Arwal, Civil Court Arwal, District Arwal, Bihar Candidates must write the name of the applied post clearly in block letters on top of the envelope.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Nationality: Applicant must be a citizen of India and registered with the State Bar Council under the Advocates Act. Practice Experience: Must be actively practicing as an advocate in courts as determined under the rules for at least 7 years. Tax Status: Must be an Assessee of Income Tax for at least the three preceding financial years from the year of application. Professional Standing: Must be an advocate with good reputation among all sections of society (male, female, and transgender). FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Filled prescribed bio-data format / application form Matriculation certificate as proof of date of birth Proof of educational qualification (Law degree certificates) Registration number and year certificate from Bar Council Certificates and IT0Rs (Income Tax Return documents) for the preceding three financial years Experience certificates and IT0Rs related to bar association practice Caste certificate (if applicable) Details of criminal history, pending or disposed of criminal cases Details of being a retainer for any notary, bank, or other institution Details of government cases handled previously and outcomes

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection is based on evaluation of experience and suitability of candidates from the panel formed by the District Magistrate, Arwal, in consultation with the District and Sessions Judge, Arwal, under the provisions of the Bihar Vidhi Padadhikari (Vachanbaddh) Niyamawali, 2023.

faq.question: Q1. What is Collectorate Arwal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is an offline recruitment process to appoint Government Pleader and Assistant Government Pleader positions in the courts of Arwal under the Bihar Vidhi Padadhikari (Vachanbaddh) Niyamawali, 2023.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for these posts?
faq.answer: The exact number of vacancies is not stated in the notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application by speed post is 31-10-2026 by 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What educational qualification is required?
faq.answer: Candidates must be law graduates and registered advocates.

faq.question: Q5. How many years of experience are required to apply?
faq.answer: Applicants must have a minimum of 7 years of active practice as an advocate in courts.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any income tax requirement for applicants?
faq.answer: Yes, applicants must have been an Income Tax Assessee for at least the preceding three financial years from the year of application.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q8. How should the application be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications must be filled in the prescribed bio-data format along with required documents and sent via speed post to the Office of the District Magistrate, Arwal.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection procedure?
faq.answer: Candidates are selected based on their experience and suitability through a panel prepared by the District Magistrate in consultation with the District and Sessions Judge, Arwal.

faq.question: Q10. What documents must be attached with the application?
faq.answer: Applicants must enclose matriculation certificates, degree certificates, Bar Council registration details, ITORs for three preceding years, caste certificates if applicable, and details of past criminal or government cases handled.
